objective: Groundwork at the coordinator request of 2026-11-17 (no study, no claims): the slow loop of SLOW-LOOP/EARN-BUDGET/SPEC-MERGE rebuilds patterns whose knots are signed (a merged distinction can enter a knot negated), and the learned agent of MEET-TRANSFER-20261117-001 reads unsigned knots only. Add signed knots and an optional initial state to a copy of its engine; gates: run-for-run identity with the current engine on unsigned patterns, an exact gauge check on signed ones, and Dr unchanged on signed patterns the slow loop rebuilds.
status: Groundwork done 2026-11-17: the agent's engine runs signed not-all-equal knots and takes an initial state; gates passed: run-for-run identity with MEET-TRANSFER's engine on unsigned patterns (144 runs), zero-sign and gauge identities (192 runs each), 3,600 small signed runs checked, Dr and D unchanged solve the slow loop's rebuilt signed patterns (median 0.55 and 0.46 of Novelty+'s flips; a sanity reading, not a result). No claims.
title: Port the navigating agent engine to signed not-all-equal knots so the slow loop can use it as its fast loop
